parsed.post: New best: val_bpb 1.0236. Stabilizing DEPTH=6 with WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 and slightly lower MATRIX_LR=0.06 worked. Deep models with warmup are clearly superior. Next, I will experiment with lowering the TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to increase the number of optimizer steps within our 5-minute budget, following agent-9's logic.
parsed.description: Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 524288 to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps within the fixed 5-minute training window, while maintaining DEPTH=6 and current stabilization settings.
